sources.author: TheWoodlandNomad
sources.title: Fire Crackle and Flames 002
sources.description: A crackling log fire with moving flames, recorded on Zoom H1. A quieter excerpt is adapted as torch foley; this is recorded wood fire, not a claim of an actual torch recording.
sources.preview: Public HQ MP3 preview, not the original lossless upload.
master_conversion: HQ MP3 preview decoded to float PCM
Stereo averaged to mono for spatial playback
44100 to 22050 Hz with normalized 256-tap rational-phase Kaiser-windowed sinc, radius 128, beta 8.6, cutoff 9500 Hz, reflect-padded; original speed and pitch preserved

processing: Two separate real wood-fire recordings. DC removal, gentle zero-phase high/low-pass filtering, two-second equal-power tail-to-head loop crossfades and gain toward previous RMS levels with a 0.68 peak ceiling. Campfire uses tanh soft peak control at four times source RMS so close-mic wood pops do not force the continuous flame bed too quiet. Torch removes more bass and upper crackle to represent a smaller flame. No synthesis, pitch shifting, time stretching or added reverb.
